env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# SPEC 2.5 (T-205): an instance of a comptime generic is checked in the
# scope of its defining package, and the instantiating package never
# resolves the generic's names. lib.Limit evaluates lib's const func Rec
# in each instance; main declares its own plain func Rec and alt its own
# const func Rec, both with lib.Rec's signature. Every instance must still
# fold lib.Rec(5) = 15.
cd w
logos build ./...
logos run ./main
stdout '^limit 15 16$'
stdout '^alt 15 16$'
stdout '^local -999 -7$'

logos eject -o out
cd out
go run ./main
stdout '^limit 15 16$'
stdout '^alt 15 16$'
stdout '^local -999 -7$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/ctshadow

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "comptime"

const func Rec(n int) int {
	if n <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return n + Rec(n-1)
}

func Limit[T any]() int {
	const limit = Rec(5)
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return limit
	} else {
		return limit + 1
	}
}

-- w/alt/alt.lgo --
package alt

import "example.com/ctshadow/lib"

const func Rec(n int) int {
	return -n - 2
}

func Limits() (int, int) {
	return lib.Limit[struct{}](), lib.Limit[int]()
}

func Local() int {
	const v = Rec(5)
	return v
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ctshadow/alt"
	"example.com/ctshadow/lib"
)

func Rec(n int) int {
	return -999
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("limit", lib.Limit[struct{}](), lib.Limit[int]())
	a, b := alt.Limits()
	fmt.Println("alt", a, b)
	fmt.Println("local", Rec(5), alt.Local())
}
